name: – Motion for a resolution
title:
MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex XVII to Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council concerning the Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) as regards lead in certain fishing tackle
(D110163/04 – 2026/2714(RPS))
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report does not change any law. It is a group of Members of the European Parliament saying no to a draft European Commission rule on lead in fishing tackle. The rule would restrict lead in certain fishing gear. The Members say the Commission has not shown that workable and affordable alternatives exist for all the gear covered. They also say the evidence on costs and benefits is too weak. They ask the Commission to withdraw the draft and bring a better-supported one.

**Key points**

- Nothing changes yet: the draft rule is rejected, not amended.
- It affects fishers, tackle makers and small businesses using lead weights.
- Next: the Commission may withdraw the draft and propose a new one.
